item.title: pyGdbToolkit: embedded debugging and security audits from GDB
item.description: H2Lab releases pyGdbToolkit, a set of GDB commands for inspecting and auditing Arm Cortex-M targets.

item.title: pySvdGenerator: generating CMSIS-SVD files from a device tree and a reference manual
item.description: H2Lab releases pySvdGenerator, a tool that generates CMSIS-SVD files by combining a Linux device tree with a SoC reference manual.

item.title: FramaCovr: from Frama-C coverage to the gcovr format
item.description: H2Lab releases FramaCovr, a tool that converts Frama-C metrics coverage reports into the gcovr format.

item.title: Welcome to the H2Lab blog
